paras: Ablepharus tragbulensis is a species of skink endemic to South Asia.
A. tragbulensis is found in India, and possibly Pakistan.

Type locality: "Tragbal [sic] Pass, at an elevation of about 9,000 feet". [= Tragbul Pass (34° 29' N, 74° 40' E), about 50 km (31 mi)  NNW of Srinagar, Kashmir, India and Pakistan, 9,000 ft (2,700 m)].
